configuration.operationInProgress: Configuration operation in progress. Keep this page open.
configuration.loadFailed: Authoritative configuration status could not be loaded.
configuration.readOnly: Your role can review this configuration but cannot change, test, activate, or roll it back.
configuration.structuralUnavailableHint: Configuration changes are disabled because the authoritative service is not structurally ready. Verify its bindings and deployment, then retry.
configuration.readinessHint: Structural readiness confirms the service is deployed. Operational readiness requires a tested active provider.
configuration.activateHint: Only a successfully tested staged version can become active. This changes production delivery behavior.
configuration.rollbackHint: Restore the previous encrypted version. This changes production behavior immediately.
configuration.writeOnlyHint: Secrets are write-only. They are encrypted after submission, never returned by the API, and cleared from this form after success.
configuration.versionHint: NEXT must pass verification before activation; PREVIOUS is retained for controlled rollback.

delivery.sms.title: SMS delivery
authentication.title: Authentication Methods
authentication.description: Audit and govern the sign-in methods exposed by CinaSeek Accounts. Runtime switches take effect within seconds; integration and deployment prerequisites remain explicit.
authentication.readOnly: Your role can audit authentication methods but cannot change production sign-in behavior.
authentication.runtimeMethodsHint: These controls change production login availability. Unavailable methods must have their prerequisite configured before they can be enabled.
authentication.relatedMethodsHint: These capabilities are managed in their owning integration or require a deployment change; their status is shown here so the authentication surface can be audited in one place.
authentication.confirmReduction: One or more production sign-in methods will be disabled immediately. Existing sessions are not revoked.
authentication.confirmEnable: The selected configured methods will become available on the Accounts sign-in page within seconds.
authentication.lockoutWarning: This change would leave no effective runtime or OAuth sign-in method. Keep at least one method available.
authentication.method.emailOtp.hint: Passwordless email login and verified first-time account creation. Requires an active email delivery provider.
authentication.method.emailPassword.hint: Signs in existing password accounts only. Separate password registration and reset remain disabled.
authentication.method.siwe.hint: Ethereum wallet proof with stage-two account creation policy. Wallet linking remains available when login is disabled.
authentication.method.passkey.hint: Shows the WebAuthn passkey login action. Passkey registration and account management remain separate.
authentication.method.googleOneTap.hint: Uses Google Identity Services with the active Google OAuth client. Standard Google OAuth remains managed separately.
authentication.method.oauth.hint: Provider credentials, enablement, and the visible provider limit are managed on Social Sign-In.
authentication.method.sso.hint: SSO providers are scoped to an explicitly selected organization.
authentication.method.phoneOtp.hint: The server plugin and SMS delivery readiness are audited here; a public login surface is not deployed.
authentication.method.magicLink.hint: Not deployed in the current passwordless Accounts contract.
authentication.method.username.hint: Not deployed in the current Accounts contract.
authentication.method.twoFactor.hint: A secondary protection layer managed by security policy and individual accounts, not a primary login switch.
authentication.reason.email_delivery_una: No operational email delivery provider is active.
authentication.reason.siwe_deployment_un: The strict SIWE runtime configuration is incomplete or disabled at deployment.
authentication.reason.google_provider_un: An enabled Google provider with a client credential pair is required.
authentication.reason.sms_delivery_unava: No operational SMS delivery provider is active.
authentication.reason.login_ui_not_deplo: Delivery is ready, but the public phone login UI is not deployed.
authentication.reason.no_active_provider: No active OAuth provider is configured.
social.title: Social Sign-In Providers
social.description: Manage social and generic OAuth credentials at runtime and control how many federated options the sign-in page shows.
social.oneTapHint: Google One Tap stays tied to the deploy-time GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID build parity check.
social.limit: Social accounts shown on the sign-in page
social.limitHint: 0 hides every federated option; 20 is the maximum. Applies server-side within seconds.
social.emailOtpHint: Email code sign-in is the only email authentication path; password login is permanently retired. Disabling it hides the email form until re-enabled.
social.genericHint: Add or edit generic OAuth endpoints. Client secrets remain write-only.
erasure.title: Privacy Erasure
erasure.description: Manage the signed downstream services that receive verified account-erasure requests.
erasure.failClosedHint: Erasure execution remains fail-closed until every staged target passes the non-destructive signed verification handshake and the version is activated.
erasure.targetIdsOnly: Only read-safe identifiers are shown. Endpoint URLs and signing secrets are never returned.
erasure.stageDescription: Replace the complete NEXT manifest. This does not affect live erasure until testing and activation succeed.
erasure.testAllHint: Runs a non-destructive signed handshake against every NEXT target. Activation remains blocked if any target fails.
